content.bridge_context: We explore how the simple leadership of the Vedic age evolved into powerful Janapadas and Mahajanapadas, and the birth of democracy in early republics like Vajji.

units.title: Janapadas and Mahajanapadas
units.explanation: Janapada means the land where people (Jana) set their foot. Powerful janapadas were called Mahajanapadas (e.g., Magadha).
units.dual_language_instruction: Look at the map of early North India. / प्रारंभिक उत्तर भारत के मानचित्र को देखें।

units.title: Varna System and Taxes
units.explanation: Society was divided into four groups (Varnas). To maintain armies and forts, kings started collecting taxes from farmers and herders.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the four Varnas (Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, Shudras). / चार वर्णों (ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य, शूद्र) की पहचान करें।
